name: @repo/ai-orb-face
description: Cartoon character orb whose expression carries the AI state — cursor-following gaze, natural blinks, thinking saccades, happy arcs and spiral eyes.

useCases: Assistant mascot that reacts as the user works
Playful alternative to a spinner or status badge
compositionHints: Expression carries the state — do not add a badge on top of it
Turn gaze off inside dense UI where many instances would be noise
Pass amplitude so the body breathes with the voice while listening
